purpose: Single Source of Truth for WHERE the cynic binary lives on each fleet machine and HOW it is deployed there. Data, not code. The previous binary-locations registry declared one path, one sha256 and one status per machine; measurement on 2026-10-19 proved all three false (the declared sha256 944753f2... exists on NO machine, and every machine carries TWO binaries in different profiles). This file replaces it and carries the measured truth.

supersedes.reason: declared sha256 and sha_baked matched no live binary on any of the three machines; the single-path model hid a two-binary-per-machine reality
supersedes.note: the superseded registry was deleted by this change; it is named here as a value, not as a live path reference

path_authority.rule: Every path below is DERIVED from infra/directory-tree.json (canonical filesystem arborescence, authority rank 4) or from the runtime_paths expansion rules it declares. No path is invented here.

expansions.${state_root}: /var/lib/cynic (infra/directory-tree.json:runtime_state.root) — the cynic principal home on a deployed node
expansions.${home}: the principal's home directory on that machine
expansions.${binary_dir}: /usr/local/bin (infra/directory-tree.json:system_binaries.root) — root-owned, NOT writable by the cynic principal

services_using.note: the cynic-node daemon, not the cynic CLI; a cynic CLI deploy does not restart it

other_binary.disposition: stale root-owned copy; NOT the deployed binary; leave alone (no principal can write it)

layout_detail.swap: atomic rename over the live file (no release/ tree on this machine)
layout_detail.note: cortex is the operator workstation: the CLI is used directly from PATH, there is no daemon

other_binary.disposition: stale root-owned copy; the operator has sudo NOPASSWD:ALL but the deployed path needs no privilege

machines.ssh_target_note: the registry alias resolves only inside the mesh DNS; it fails from cortex and from builder. The IP form works from both. Try the alias, then the fallback.

layout_detail.swap: atomic rename over the live file (no releases/ or current/ tree on this machine)
layout_detail.note: no service consumes the cynic CLI here; the binary is the agent-host entry point

machines.privilege_note: no sudo grant at all on this machine (sudo requires a password): any deploy step needing privilege is blocked here. The principal-owned deploy path needs none.

other_binary.disposition: stale root-owned copy; NOT writable by the principal

layout_detail.swap: atomic rename over the live file (no releases/ or current/ tree on this machine)
layout_detail.note: measured 2026-10-25: /var/lib/cynic/releases does not exist; the binaries were placed by hand. Adopting the releases/ + current layout is a separate, explicit step.

services_using.note: build_runner control plane, health http://192.168.0.25:9090/health (200 measured 2026-10-25). The daemon is the cynic-node binary (sha256 4ba74af21c7f55fd, 2026-10-23), a separate file: a cynic CLI deploy does not replace it or restart this unit.

anti_rules: No machine-local absolute path outside infra/directory-tree.json — derive from ${state_root} / ${home} / ${binary_dir}
No hostname outside infra/registry.json node ids
A declared sha256 must be a MEASURED value, never a copy of another machine's
One deploy path per machine — the one the principal can write and the services use
